entries.en: He reacted disagreeably when we asked him to lower the music.
entries.zh: 我们请他把音乐调小时，他作出了令人不快的反应。

entries.en: The chef invited us to a degustation of three olive oils.
entries.zh: 厨师邀请我们品尝比较三种橄榄油。

entries.en: We need to thin out the seedlings before their roots become crowded.
entries.zh: 在根部变得拥挤之前，我们需要给幼苗间苗。

entries.en: The course compares the legal system of each neighboring country.
entries.zh: 这门课程比较了各邻国的法律体系。

entries.en: The brain model uses a pale color to represent white matter.
entries.zh: 大脑模型用浅色表示白质。

entries.en: The election debate included questions about trade policy.
entries.zh: 竞选辩论包括有关贸易政策的问题。

entries.en: She regarded the unauthorized recording as an invasion of privacy.
entries.zh: 她认为未经许可录音侵犯了隐私。

entries.en: The newspaper's veteran penman wrote a moving account of the rescue.
entries.zh: 这家报纸的资深撰稿人写下了一篇感人的救援报道。

entries.en: The inspector noted the kitchen's uncleanliness in his report.
entries.zh: 检查员在报告中指出了厨房不清洁的问题。

entries.en: The old power plant is being converted into an arts center.
entries.zh: 这座旧发电厂正在被改建为艺术中心。

entries.en: A church member volunteered to repair the garden wall.
entries.zh: 一位教会会员自愿修理花园围墙。

entries.en: The museum displayed portraits of the royal family.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了王室成员的肖像。

entries.en: My sister starts junior high school in September.
entries.zh: 我妹妹九月开始上初中。

entries.en: The referee checked the rule book before restarting the match.
entries.zh: 裁判查阅比赛规则手册后，才让比赛重新开始。

entries.en: She chose a blue shirtdress with wooden buttons.
entries.zh: 她选了一件带木纽扣的蓝色衬衣式连衣裙。

entries.en: The document records the tenant's decease and the transfer of the lease.
entries.zh: 这份文件记录了租户的死亡以及租约的转让。

entries.en: He wore a white cotton kurta to the family celebration.
entries.zh: 他穿着一件白色棉质无领长衫参加家庭庆祝活动。

entries.en: The runner reached second base just before the throw.
entries.zh: 跑者在传球到达前一刻跑上了二垒。

entries.en: She earned a double first before beginning her research career.
entries.zh: 她在两门学科都取得一等荣誉成绩后，开始了研究生涯。

entries.en: The volunteers managed to pull off a concert with almost no budget.
entries.zh: 志愿者们几乎没有预算，却成功办成了一场音乐会。

entries.en: The mayor promised to make good on her pledge to reopen the library.
entries.zh: 市长承诺履行重新开放图书馆的诺言。

entries.en: The travelers reached the rest house shortly before sunset.
entries.zh: 旅行者们在日落前不久到达了客栈。

entries.en: The critic complained about the film's relentless averageness.
entries.zh: 评论家抱怨这部电影从头到尾都很平庸。

entries.en: The case notes describe induration around the old scar.
entries.zh: 病例记录描述了旧疤痕周围的硬结。

entries.en: The log records both the clock time and the elapsed time.
entries.zh: 日志同时记录了钟表时间和已过去的时间。

entries.en: Workers lined up beside the time clock at the shift change.
entries.zh: 换班时，工人们在考勤钟旁排队。

entries.en: The children jumped for joy when the excursion was confirmed.
entries.zh: 郊游确定成行时，孩子们高兴得跳了起来。

entries.en: The family business grew into a major business concern.
entries.zh: 这家家族企业发展成了一家大型公司。

entries.en: The company will phase out plastic packaging over three years.
entries.zh: 这家公司将在三年内逐步淘汰塑料包装。

entries.en: It is good form to thank the host before leaving.
entries.zh: 离开前向主人致谢是有礼貌的举动。

entries.en: She poured chilled limeade into four tall glasses.
entries.zh: 她把冰镇酸橙饮料倒进了四个高杯中。

entries.en: Wake up, sleepyhead; the bus leaves in twenty minutes.
entries.zh: 醒醒，贪睡鬼，巴士二十分钟后就开了。

entries.en: The gardener cut open a ripe medlar to show its seeds.
entries.zh: 园丁切开了一个熟欧楂果，展示里面的种子。

entries.en: The news story described the bridge closure without naming its cause.
entries.zh: 新闻报道描述了大桥封闭的情况，但未说明原因。

entries.en: A volunteer directed the injured runner to the first-aid station.
entries.zh: 一位志愿者把受伤的跑者引向急救站。

entries.en: The exhibition traced changes in the city's coastal defence system.
entries.zh: 展览追溯了这座城市海岸防卫系统的变化。

entries.en: Please send the signed forms to our main office.
entries.zh: 请把签好的表格寄到我们的总公司。

entries.en: The club switched from stroke play to match play for the final event.
entries.zh: 俱乐部将最后一项赛事由比杆赛改为比洞赛。

entries.en: The research report grouped the records by presence of hypercholesterolemia.
entries.zh: 研究报告按是否存在高胆固醇血症对记录进行了分组。

entries.en: The minister prepared documents before the parliamentary interpellation.
entries.zh: 部长在议会质询前准备了文件。

entries.en: A silver clasp fastened the velvet neckband.
entries.zh: 一个银扣扣住了天鹅绒领圈。

entries.en: The royal house commissioned a portrait of the young heir.
entries.zh: 王室委托人画了一幅年轻继承人的肖像。

entries.en: The engineer tested the television system before the live broadcast.
entries.zh: 工程师在直播前测试了电视系统。

entries.en: The back judge signaled as the football struck the ground.
entries.zh: 橄榄球落地时，后方裁判员作出了手势。

entries.en: Years of cycling in traffic gave her excellent road sense.
entries.zh: 多年在车流中骑车，让她具备了出色的道路安全意识。

entries.en: After carrying the furniture upstairs, we were all in.
entries.zh: 把家具搬上楼后，我们累坏了。

entries.en: The seminar examined price control during a period of severe shortages.
entries.zh: 研讨课考察了严重短缺时期的物价管制。

entries.en: The merchant accepted a time draft payable in ninety days.
entries.zh: 商人接受了一张九十天后付款的定期汇票。

entries.en: The moon's effulgence lit the snow-covered courtyard.
entries.zh: 月亮的光辉照亮了积雪的庭院。

entries.en: The clinical notes include a description of conjunctival redness.
entries.zh: 临床记录中有一段对结膜发红的描述。

entries.en: The faded typewriting was difficult to read near the bottom of the page.
entries.zh: 页面底部褪色的打字文字很难辨认。

entries.en: Keep the work surface clear while you measure the fabric.
entries.zh: 量布料时，请让工作台面保持空旷。

entries.en: The committee invited small businesses to comment on tax policy.
entries.zh: 委员会邀请小企业就税收政策发表意见。

entries.en: The lettering began to wear off after years of use.
entries.zh: 使用多年后，字样开始磨掉。

entries.en: The memoir describes his first job as an office boy.
entries.zh: 回忆录描述了他当办公室勤杂工的第一份工作。

entries.en: The union took a hard line over unpaid overtime.
entries.zh: 工会对无偿加班采取了强硬立场。

entries.en: The medical lecture included a brief discussion of priapism.
entries.zh: 医学讲座简要讨论了阴茎异常勃起。

entries.en: My brother's grandson, my only grandnephew, visited us in June.
entries.zh: 我唯一的侄孙，也就是我兄弟的孙子，六月来看望了我们。

entries.en: The skirl of bagpipes drifted across the field.
entries.zh: 风笛的尖厉声飘过田野。

entries.en: The woman of the house welcomed the guests into the kitchen.
entries.zh: 女主人把客人迎进了厨房。

entries.en: The tenancy agreement explains who is responsible for council tax.
entries.zh: 租赁协议说明了谁负责缴纳地方议会税。

entries.en: Write the day of the week beside each date.
entries.zh: 在每个日期旁写上星期几。

entries.en: The confidence man persuaded strangers to invest in a nonexistent mine.
entries.zh: 骗子说服陌生人投资一座根本不存在的矿。

entries.en: The medical student borrowed an anatomical atlas from the library.
entries.zh: 医学生从图书馆借了一本解剖图谱。

entries.en: She did not shrink from the difficult task of questioning the witness.
entries.zh: 她没有因害怕而回避询问证人这项困难的任务。

entries.en: The dispute raised questions about international law and maritime boundaries.
entries.zh: 这场争端引出了有关国际法和海上边界的问题。

entries.en: The enlarged retina model marks the fovea with a small circle.
entries.zh: 放大的视网膜模型用小圆圈标出了中央凹。

entries.en: The report questions the harmfulness of the discarded material.
entries.zh: 报告对这些废弃材料的危害性提出了质疑。

entries.en: The historian examined how older medical texts discussed onanism.
entries.zh: 历史学家考察了早期医学文献如何讨论手淫。

entries.en: The defending team struck back with a goal before halftime.
entries.zh: 防守方球队在中场休息前进球回击。

entries.en: The students recorded the magnetic needle's angle of dip.
entries.zh: 学生们记录了磁针的磁倾角。

entries.en: The essay argues that an open society needs independent newspapers.
entries.zh: 文章认为，开放社会需要独立报纸。

entries.en: The historian linked the official portraits to a growing cult of personality.
entries.zh: 历史学家把官方肖像与日益加深的个人崇拜联系起来。

entries.en: They decided to live it up on their last night in town.
entries.zh: 他们决定在城里的最后一晚尽情玩乐。

entries.en: The expedition's departure will hinge on the weather forecast.
entries.zh: 探险队何时出发将取决于天气预报。

entries.en: The prospectus identifies the bonds that are callable before maturity.
entries.zh: 招股说明书列明了哪些债券可在到期前赎回。

entries.en: The market stall sold tinware beside wooden kitchen utensils.
entries.zh: 这个集市摊位在木制厨具旁出售洋铁制品。

entries.en: The teacher used "sea" and "see" to illustrate homophony.
entries.zh: 老师用“sea”和“see”来说明同音现象。

entries.en: The lender registered a security interest in the equipment.
entries.zh: 贷款人登记了对这批设备的担保权益。

entries.en: The magazine brought high style to readers far from the capital.
entries.zh: 这本杂志把时髦风尚带给了远离首都的读者。

entries.en: The pamphlet interpreted the strike as an episode of class war.
entries.zh: 这本小册子把罢工解读为阶级斗争中的一个事件。

entries.en: A hidden fan produced the stage effect of wind in the trees.
entries.zh: 一台隐藏的风扇制造出了风吹树林的舞台效果。

entries.en: What time does your train get in tonight?
entries.zh: 你的火车今晚几点到？

entries.en: We have to get up early to catch the ferry.
entries.zh: 我们得早起，才能赶上渡轮。

entries.en: The class sent her a card hoping she would get well soon.
entries.zh: 全班给她寄去一张卡片，希望她早日康复。

entries.en: The old clinical register lists otalgia among the patient's symptoms.
entries.zh: 旧临床登记簿将耳痛列为这名患者的症状之一。

entries.en: The meeting ended in an unedifying argument about personal expenses.
entries.zh: 会议以一场围绕个人开支的不体面争吵结束。

entries.en: The grant opened opportunities that were undreamt of a year earlier.
entries.zh: 这笔资助带来了在一年前还无法想象的机会。

entries.en: Let me get down your address before I forget.
entries.zh: 让我把你的地址写下来，免得忘了。

entries.en: The military record notes an absence without leave during training.
entries.zh: 军事档案记录了一次训练期间擅自离队的情况。

entries.en: She signed the stock power in the presence of a witness.
entries.zh: 她在见证人在场时签署了股票转让授权书。

entries.en: One unusual data point prompted us to check the original measurement.
entries.zh: 一个异常数据点促使我们检查原始测量结果。

entries.en: The council refused to give ear to the residents' objections.
entries.zh: 议会拒绝倾听居民的反对意见。

entries.en: He got off his high horse when he realized he needed our help.
entries.zh: 意识到需要我们帮助后，他放下了高傲的架子。

entries.en: The community marked adulthood with a traditional rite of passage.
entries.zh: 这个社群以传统的成年仪式标志成年。

entries.en: She found the missing gloves in the chiffoniers beside the wardrobe.
entries.zh: 她在衣柜旁的高五斗橱中找到了丢失的手套。

entries.en: The aviation museum displayed a bombsight behind protective glass.
entries.zh: 航空博物馆在防护玻璃后展出了一具投弹瞄准器。

entries.en: The botanical illustration shows an ackee split open on the branch.
entries.zh: 植物插图显示了一枚在枝头裂开的西非荔枝果。

entries.en: He used exaggerated baby talk to amuse his infant niece.
entries.zh: 他用夸张的儿语逗弄还是婴儿的侄女。

entries.en: The company added a smaller model to its product line.
entries.zh: 这家公司在产品系列中增加了一个较小的型号。

entries.en: On Sunday afternoons, we drive around with no particular destination.
entries.zh: 周日下午，我们开车兜风，没有特定的目的地。

entries.en: The old album fell open at a photograph of the harbor.
entries.zh: 旧相册自然翻开到了港口照片的那一页。

entries.en: After the files vanished, we rebuilt the schedule from scratch.
entries.zh: 文件消失后，我们从头重新制订了时间表。

entries.en: Cold water helped wash out the fresh paint from the cloth.
entries.zh: 冷水帮助洗掉了布上未干的颜料。

entries.en: A life scientist joined the team to study the pond's microorganisms.
entries.zh: 一位生命科学家加入团队，研究池塘中的微生物。

entries.en: The researcher found phenylpropanolamine listed in an archived laboratory inventory.
entries.zh: 研究者在存档的实验室库存清单中发现了苯丙醇胺。

entries.en: The experiment compared muscle contractility under controlled laboratory conditions.
entries.zh: 实验在受控实验室条件下比较了肌肉收缩性。

entries.en: We held a short meeting to iron out the remaining disagreements.
entries.zh: 我们开了一个简短会议，消除剩下的分歧。

entries.en: Stop messing about and help us load the van.
entries.zh: 别再瞎磨蹭了，来帮我们装车。

entries.en: The crisis helped draw together groups that had rarely cooperated.
entries.zh: 这场危机促使原本很少合作的团体团结起来。

entries.en: The report states the time-scale factor used to relate simulated time to real process time.
entries.zh: 报告列明了用于关联模拟时间与实际过程时间的时标因子。

entries.en: She poured out her worries during the walk home.
entries.zh: 回家途中，她倾诉了自己的担忧。

entries.en: The hotel offered a cut rate to travelers stranded by the storm.
entries.zh: 酒店向因暴风雨滞留的旅客提供了优惠价。

entries.en: He stretched out his hand to catch the falling glass.
entries.zh: 他伸出手去接正在掉落的杯子。

entries.en: The museum label describes the fabric used for the breechcloth.
entries.zh: 博物馆的标签介绍了这块腰布所用的织物。

entries.en: Their companionate marriage was built on shared interests and mutual respect.
entries.zh: 他们伙伴式的婚姻建立在共同兴趣和相互尊重的基础上。

entries.en: He invented a cock-and-bull story to explain the missing bicycle.
entries.zh: 他编了一套荒诞说辞，解释自行车为何不见了。

entries.en: The legal history lecture examined a medieval writ of right.
entries.zh: 法律史讲座考察了一份中世纪权利令。

entries.en: The volunteers dished out bowls of hot soup.
entries.zh: 志愿者们分发了一碗碗热汤。

entries.en: The report recommends additional training for the police force.
entries.zh: 报告建议为警察部门增加培训。

entries.en: A sudden downpour delayed the outdoor dog show.
entries.zh: 一场突如其来的大雨推迟了户外犬展比赛。

entries.en: She chose a stage name that audiences could easily remember.
entries.zh: 她选了一个观众容易记住的艺名。

entries.en: The hedger trimmed the overgrown branches along the lane.
entries.zh: 修篱工剪去了小路旁过度生长的枝条。

entries.en: The novel introduces him as a hungry scrag in a borrowed coat.
entries.zh: 小说最初把他描写成一个穿着借来外套、饥肠辘辘的瘦骨伶仃的人。

entries.en: The temptation proved resistible once she remembered her savings goal.
entries.zh: 她一想起自己的储蓄目标，就发现这个诱惑是可以抵挡的。

entries.en: Can I sleep over at Maya's after the concert?
entries.zh: 音乐会后，我能在玛雅家过夜吗？

entries.en: The actor rushed out from behind the curtain and startled the audience.
entries.zh: 演员从幕布后冲出，吓了观众一跳。

entries.en: The packaging displays the trade name above the ingredient list.
entries.zh: 包装上把商品名印在配料表上方。

entries.en: A falling branch knocked out the fictional explorer.
entries.zh: 一根落下的树枝把故事中的探险家击昏了。

entries.en: She studies art history and volunteers at the sculpture gallery.
entries.zh: 她学习艺术史，还在雕塑展馆做志愿者。

entries.en: The kingfisher crossed the stream in a flash.
entries.zh: 翠鸟一瞬间就飞过了小溪。

entries.en: The remote cottage has a land line but no mobile reception.
entries.zh: 偏远小屋有固定电话线路，却没有手机信号。

entries.en: The conservation team plans to translocate the animals to a protected island.
entries.zh: 保护团队计划把这些动物迁移到一座受保护的岛屿。

entries.en: The carpenters lifted the ridgepole into place above the rafters.
entries.zh: 木匠们把屋脊梁吊装到椽子上方的位置。

entries.en: The training diagram distinguishes enteral routes from other delivery routes.
entries.zh: 培训图示区分了肠内途径与其他输送途径。

entries.en: The brain diagram marks an association area behind the sensory cortex.
entries.zh: 大脑图示在感觉皮层后方标出了一个联合区。

entries.en: A fox came forth from the trees at dusk.
entries.zh: 黄昏时，一只狐狸从树林里走了出来。

entries.en: The property file lists a first mortgage held by the bank.
entries.zh: 房产档案列有银行持有的一项第一抵押权。

entries.en: The laboratory report compares the heat of transformation of two materials.
entries.zh: 实验室报告比较了两种材料的转变热。

entries.en: I sympathize with anyone who has to wait outside in this weather.
entries.zh: 我同情任何不得不在这种天气里在外等候的人。

entries.en: She gave birth to a daughter in the spring.
entries.zh: 她在春天生了一个女儿。

entries.en: The restorer inspected the sparker fitted above the old fireplace.
entries.zh: 修复人员检查了装在旧壁炉上方的火花捕捉器。

entries.en: The fair included a stall advertising palmistry.
entries.zh: 集市上有一个打广告招徕看手相生意的摊位。

entries.en: The surgical history lists a nephrectomy performed many years earlier.
entries.zh: 手术史记载了一次多年前进行的肾切除术。

entries.en: The journalist investigated hiring through the old boy network.
entries.zh: 记者调查了通过老校友关系网招聘的做法。

entries.en: Her first cousin, the son of her mother's sister, lives nearby.
entries.zh: 她的一位表亲，也就是她姨妈的儿子，住在附近。

entries.en: The general staff reviewed maps before the exercise.
entries.zh: 参谋部在演习前审阅了地图。

entries.en: The logic exercise asks students to identify the major term in the syllogism.
entries.zh: 这道逻辑练习要求学生找出三段论中的大项。

entries.en: The conference room is booked until three o'clock.
entries.zh: 会议室已经被预订到三点。

entries.en: She plans to take time off from work to repair the house.
entries.zh: 她计划暂时休假，修理房子。

entries.en: The academy offers a course on the history of military law.
entries.zh: 这所学院开设了一门军法史课程。

entries.en: He responded pugnaciously to even the mildest criticism.
entries.zh: 即使面对最温和的批评，他也以挑衅好争的态度回应。

entries.meaningZh: 使外界态度形成内心形象
entries.en: The seminar examined how children may introject a parent's demanding attitudes.
entries.zh: 研讨课探讨了儿童如何可能把父母苛求的态度内化。

entries.en: We ordered the replacement parts cash on delivery.
entries.zh: 我们以货到付款的方式订购了替换零件。

entries.en: The textbook uses a put option to illustrate the right to sell.
entries.zh: 教材用看跌期权说明出售的权利。

entries.en: We agreed to avoid shop talk during the picnic.
entries.zh: 我们说好野餐时不谈工作。

entries.en: The two architects talked shop throughout dinner.
entries.zh: 这两位建筑师整个晚饭期间都在谈本行的事。

entries.en: The mechanic inspected the drive line after hearing the vibration.
entries.zh: 技师听到振动声后，检查了传动系统。

entries.en: Her line drive passed just above the shortstop's glove.
entries.zh: 她打出的平直球刚好从游击手的手套上方飞过。

entries.en: My term paper compares two accounts of the same expedition.
entries.zh: 我的学期论文比较了对同一次探险的两种记述。

entries.en: Her pertinacity kept the restoration project alive through repeated setbacks.
entries.zh: 她的顽强让修复项目在屡次受挫后仍得以继续。

entries.en: The laboratory measured the extractable oil in each seed sample.
entries.zh: 实验室测量了每份种子样品中可提取的油量。

entries.en: A group discussion followed the documentary screening.
entries.zh: 纪录片放映后进行了一场集体讨论。

entries.en: The office staff moved the records to a larger cupboard.
entries.zh: 办公室职员把记录搬进了一个更大的柜子。

entries.en: Look sharp, or we will miss the last bus.
entries.zh: 快点，不然我们就赶不上末班车了。

entries.en: The model treats the distant lamp as a point source.
entries.zh: 模型把远处的灯视为点光源。

entries.en: The archaeologist used a narrow probe to dig into the compacted soil.
entries.zh: 考古学家用细探针探入了压实的土层。

entries.en: A government agent visited the warehouse to inspect the records.
entries.zh: 一位政府代表到仓库检查记录。

entries.en: His irascibility made even routine meetings tense.
entries.zh: 他易怒的脾气让例会也变得紧张。

entries.en: She smiled inscrutably and closed the envelope.
entries.zh: 她高深莫测地笑了笑，合上了信封。

entries.en: He tied a slipknot in the rope before lowering the bucket.
entries.zh: 他在绳子上打了个活结，然后放下水桶。

entries.en: The pond began to ice over during the night.
entries.zh: 池塘在夜间开始结冰。

entries.en: The shop added a health food section beside the bakery.
entries.zh: 商店在面包区旁增设了一个保健食品区。

entries.en: The analyst compared the price-to-earnings ratio of three companies.
entries.zh: 分析师比较了三家公司的市盈率。

entries.en: Her calm straight man made the comedian's wild stories even funnier.
entries.zh: 她那位镇定的捧哏搭档让喜剧演员的离奇故事更好笑了。

entries.en: The old suitcase began to come apart at the seams.
entries.zh: 旧行李箱开始从接缝处散开。
